premise_accepted_quote: Selectivity is a ratio, not an absolute.** Low-dose logic only works if off-targets sit well to the right of your efficacious free exposure. If a close family member or an unrelated liability (hERG, 5-HT2B, a kinase, etc.) is within 10-30x, you can hit it at the exposures needed for efficacy. You don't know the ratio until you run the panel.

citations.text: Redfern et al., Cardiovasc Res 2003 (hERG/QT safety margins and torsades risk).
Bowes et al., Nat Rev Drug Discov 2012 (in vitro pharmacological profiling and safety-related attrition).
Whitebread et al., Drug Discov Today 2005 (in vitro safety pharmacology profiling panels).
